reported_fitted_or_used.name: Gecko G540 stepper drive
reported_fitted_or_used.source_line: The owner tested slotted optical switches using a 5 V supply and 250 Ω resistor on the LED side, then connected the open-collector output to a G540 input and its ground. LinuxCNC HALmeter showed the parallel-port input switching. The owner had ordered an Omron E6C2-CWZ6C 60 P/R encoder and was designing a spindle mounting arrangement; a completed encoder installation is not established by the first-cut post.
